subject: Request: Vendr presign ownership and proof-of-possession for S3 manifests
messages:
From: Priya Singh <security@novumcloud.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: vendor-intake@novumcloud.com
Date: 2026-11-24T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Request: Vendr presign ownership and proof-of-possession for S3 manifests

Ben —

We're onboarding your Vendr profile into our supply chain ingestion and need a quick confirmation of who owns the presign flow for object uploads and how Redwood is proving possession of the related S3 manifests for audit. Specifically, the vendor portal flagged: 1) presigned URL generator identity, 2) rotation cadence for presign keys, and 3) evidence that the S3 manifests you reference are actually held by Redwood (hashes/manifest file).

Can you: 
- Confirm the owning principal (service account or Redwood-managed presign endpoint)
- Provide a short manifest sample (CSV/JSON) with object keys + checksums or a pointer to where we can fetch it
- Share any IAM policy snippet and a sample presigned URL (redacted) so our intake team can validate access scoping

We prefer a single uploaded bundle in Vendr (or a shared Drive link) by EOD Friday PT so we can complete the CAIQ field mapping. If there's a preferred format or anything that needs to be redacted, let me know.

Attaching our intake checklist for reference.

Thanks —
Priya Singh
Senior Vendor Security Analyst
NovumCloud Security

Attachment: novumcloud_intake_checklist.pdf (stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Priya Singh <security@novumcloud.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-24T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Vendr presign ownership and proof-of-possession for S3 manifests

Hi Priya —

Thanks for the clear checklist. We're happy to get you everything you need. Quick answers up front: 
- Owning principal: the presign URLs are generated by a Redwood service account (redwood-presign@redwood-svc) scoped to a dedicated bucket for vendor manifests (vendor-manifests-prod).
- Rotation cadence: presign signing keys rotate monthly; we keep a 90-day history of signatures for inspection.
- Evidence: we can provide a sample manifest (CSV) with object paths + SHA256 checksums, an IAM policy snippet, and a redacted presigned URL for verification.

I've attached a minimal manifest sample and a short instructions stub — Marissa will upload the full manifest bundle to the Vendr portal unless you prefer the Drive link in my signature. Karthik, can you pull the IAM policy snippet (redacted) and the presign key rotation notes into a short text file?

Can we target EOD Friday PT (2026-11-27) for the full bundle? If you need it sooner, call out which items are urgent and we'll prioritize. Also happy to schedule a 20‑minute walkthrough if that helps.

Ben
Ben Carter
Vendor Security Liaison | Redwood Inference

Attachments: vendr_manifest_sample.csv (stub), presign-instructions-stub.txt (stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-24T10:08:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: NovumCloud Vendr intake — action items (short)

Karthik / Marissa —

Looping you in to get this over the line. Priya asked for: 
- owner principal confirmation (done above)
- sample manifest w/ SHA256 (attached sample)
- IAM policy snippet (redact ARNs) 
- one example presigned URL (redacted)

Proposed split: 
- Karthik: produce iam_policy_redacted.txt + presign_key_rotation_notes.md (include rotation cadence, who has key access, KMS key alias) — aim EOD 11/25 PT
- Marissa: compile full manifest bundle for vendor-manifests-prod bucket, include a small sample of object checksums, and upload the zip to the Vendr portal under the NovumCloud intake (or drop to the shared Drive folder linked below). Also include a short README that lists files and how to validate checksums — aim EOD 11/26 PT

When you upload, please set the Vendr asset label to: novumcloud/vendor-manifests/202611 and paste the portal URL into my reply. Karthik, confirm whether we should include an IAM snapshot (policy simulator output) or just the policy text — Priya will likely ask for simulator output during audit.

Thanks —
Ben

> On 2026-11-24 09:15, Priya Singh <security@novumcloud.com> wrote:
> > Ben —
> > 
> > We're onboarding your Vendr profile into our supply chain ingestion and need a quick confirmation ...

From: Priya Singh <security@novumcloud.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: vendor-intake@novumcloud.com
Date: 2026-11-26T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Vendr presign ownership and proof-of-possession for S3 manifests

Ben —

Appreciate the quick response and the sample attachments. A couple of quick asks before we close the intake ticket: 
- Please paste the Vendr upload URL when Marissa completes the upload so we can pick it up automatically.
- For the IAM evidence, if you can include a simulator output (policy evaluation for the presign generator principal), that reduces follow-up questions.
- Can you also confirm the internal contact for audit questions (name + email + phone)? We'll keep that contact on the audit distribution list.

If you hit any blocker with the portal upload, the Drive link you included will work as a fallback. Looking forward to the manifest bundle — if you can meet EOD PT on 11/27 that's perfect.

Best,
Priya Singh
NovumCloud Security

Attachment: intake_checklist_completed_stub.txt (stub)
